rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an island.

example.english: We are going to that island on vacation.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 go2 go3 dou2 leoi5 haang4

rows.note: Use 海島 when specifically referring to an island in the sea rather than a river or lake.

example.english: That island in the sea is surrounded by water and has beautiful scenery.
example.traditional: 嗰個海島四面都係海，風景好靚。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hoi2 dou2 sei3 min6 dou1 hai6 hoi2 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use 島嶼 mainly in formal or written contexts as a more literary equivalent of 島.

example.english: This island has preserved many natural landscapes.
example.traditional: 呢座島嶼保留咗不少天然景觀。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 dou2 zeoi6 bou2 lau4 zo2 bat1 siu2 tin1 jin4 ging2 gun1
